messages:
maria: kicking off tenant-id -> uuid migration during the 02:00 UTC quiet window. will run a canary (1% tenants) -> 10% -> full. plan: add column, incremental backfill in small batches, swap fk, deprecate old col with TTL. holding for deploybot checkpoints. cc @oncall

deploybot: Deploy triggered: migration-service v3.4.1. HOLDPOINT: canary start. To proceed react with :white_check_mark: or respond 'proceed'. Automations will enforce quiesce window.

aj: canary started on shard s-17 (1%). tailing logs and replication lag. batch_size=1000 initially.

leo: seeing a long-running delete on analytics_events on s-17, looks like adhoc cleanup. that might conflict with row-level updates from the backfill.

sam: that adhoc cleanup is the nightly cleanup job — i can pause it for the window. pausing now. :white_check_mark:

aj: replication lag spiked to ~30s during first big batch. dropping batch_size to 500 and throttling workers. will monitor.

maria: good catch. deploybot — canary holdpoint metrics request: please post 95th latency, error rate, and avg lock wait for s-17.

deploybot: Canary metrics for s-17 -> cpu 62%, 95p latency 220ms (baseline 200ms), error rate 0.1%, avg row_lock_wait 120ms. No fatal errors. Recommend proceed to staged 10%? react with :eyes: if you want a pause.

leo: agree to bump but target eu-west first for 10% (keep other regions paused).

aj: starting 10% in eu-west on shards s-22..s-26 with batch_size=500 workers=4.

ops-bot: alert @channel: observed lock_wait >200ms on analytics_events (s-23) at 10:05 UTC — 2 queries blocked by migration session id=3456.

sam: aborting advance to global 10%. rolling back migration on s-22..s-23 immediately. deploybot: initiate rollback for those shards.

deploybot: Rollback requested for shards s-22,s-23. rollback-status: in_progress -> rollback-complete. feature_flag tenant_id_migration set to OFF for affected shards.

maria: good call. keep the rest of the canary paused. open a 30m debug window; quick huddle in #eng-releases at 10:35 UTC to triage root cause.

aj: logs show the backfill update hit an unindexed filter on analytics_events(user_id) and held a rowlock while updating batches. we need an index.

leo: creating the index before retry would avoid rowlock escalation. prefer CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY to avoid locks, but it adds IO.

maria: agreed — plan: create index concurrently during low traffic, validate, then resume canary. preflight SQL to run during quiet window:

```
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_analytics_events_user_id ON analytics_events (user_id);
```

sam: scheduling concurrent index create in ~40m (10:40 UTC). i'll monitor replication lag and IO.

deploybot: Holdpoint updated. Resume decision scheduled at 10:40 UTC after index create and 10m verification. Referenced runbooks: migration-locks, rollback-hatch.

maria: added note to release notes: "Paused tenant-id->uuid migration due to unexpected rowlock on analytics_events. Resolving by adding concurrent index; will resume after verification."

aj: thanks — will re-run a small 1% canary post-index and report metrics.

leo: thumbs up. leave shard s-22..s-23 in rollback state until verification complete.

sam: will post status updates here when index create starts and completes.

maria: excellent teamwork. keep alerts on, and ping if anything >250ms lock_wait.
